v3.name: journal
v3.what: R1: every agent step written ahead to the job journal

v3.name: resume
v3.what: R2: a turn the daemon lost (crash, power) continues from its journal

v3.name: offline
v3.what: R3: a model step waits for the network instead of failing the turn

v3.name: rate_limit
v3.what: W9: per-provider request pacing (token bucket)

v3.name: redact
v3.what: W9: secrets in tool output are replaced by placeholders before any model sees them

v3.name: untrusted
v3.what: W9: web pages and fetched text are marked as data, never instructions

v3.name: search
v3.what: W3: the indexed, .gitignore-aware search engine

v3.name: receipt
v3.what: I10: a token receipt after every agent turn

v3.name: privacy
v3.what: I6: files marked secret in .sdc/policy.toml never reach a model

v3.name: fleet
v3.what: I7: the fleet_run tool - one command on many servers, outputs clustered (adds a tool, so off unless switched on)

v3.name: budget
v3.what: I5: @budget 40k / @budget $0.10 in a message

v3.name: stable_prefix
v3.what: W5: nothing volatile (today's date) in the cached prefix

v3.name: tool_pruning
v3.what: W5: only the tools the task's intent needs

v3.name: ledger_diff
v3.what: I1: a re-read of a changed file is sent as a diff

v3.name: skeleton
v3.what: I2: files over 200 lines are read as an outline first

v3.name: recipes
v3.what: I4/L2: a recipe from a similar verified task in .sdc/recipes is sent with the request

v3.name: interlingua
v3.what: I8: one English task brief per message, answer in the person's language

v3.name: intel
v3.what: W4: the find_symbol and symbols tools - where the project's declarations are (adds tools, so off unless switched on)

v3.name: repomap
v3.what: W4: a map of the project's declarations, ranked for the request, travels with it

v3.name: memory
v3.what: L0: only the memory facts the request touches are sent, not the whole file

v3.name: lessons
v3.what: L1: a lesson from a step that failed in this project, and what worked instead

v3.name: knowledge
v3.what: L3: a page an earlier turn fetched is sent again as a short excerpt with its address and date

v3.name: knowledge_core
v3.what: I11: learned knowledge needs two sightings, must not contradict what is known, and is taken back when it proves wrong

v3.name: cas
v3.what: W7a: a file's old content is kept by its own hash before SDC changes it, so a turn can be taken back without git

v3.name: router
v3.what: W6: a plainly light request goes to the fast model named in router.fast; everything else stays on the main model

v3.name: effort
v3.what: Q5: a small model is given room to think and one instruction to lean on the tools

v3.name: cascade
v3.what: I3: when the draft model is stuck, cascade.strong takes the task over from a capsule of its state

v3.name: terms
v3.what: G37: a site's robots.txt decides before SDC reads a page, and a crawl delay is given

v3.name: bandit
v3.what: L4: which model wins for which kind of task is learned from the turns themselves

v3.name: runner
v3.what: R4: a project's turns can run on the VPS the person names in `.sdc/runners.toml`

v3.name: automations
v3.what: AUTO: a request SDC runs on a clock, whose answer waits in the Inbox

v3.name: parallel
v3.what: PAR: several agents at once, each in its own git worktree, on one board
